name: Ryoujoku Joshi Gakuen
source:
A strict prestigious girls school. There is even a rumor that even the examination of the underwear is done here in the name of guidance. There is a girl under suspicion who is ordered to pass underwear examination and virginity check.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一所严格的名牌女子学校。甚至有传言，连内衣的检查都是以指导的名义在这里进行的。有一名受到怀疑的女孩被勒令通过内衣检查和贞操检查。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
